feature: Colour swatches in Animate a property
summary: In the Animate a property list, a colour value (Color, Shadow color, Border color) now shows a small swatch of the colour it has now, where number values show the diamond.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no flag changed from its default. Open the sample recording.

try.do: Press T and click the canvas, type a word, then press Command Return.
In Properties, click Animate a property.
Look at the Color row under Appearance: a white square stands where the other rows have a diamond.
Scroll to Shadow 2 color and check its swatch is the shadow's colour.
Change the title's colour in the panel, open the list again, and check the swatch follows.

evaluate: Can you tell at a glance which values in the list are colours?
Does a white or black swatch still read as a square against the list, in light and in dark?
Is the swatch the same size and weight as the diamonds beside it, or does it shout?
rough: Matches the mock's swatch (video.html, Animate a property list: 12 point square, 3 point corners, the low edge round it).

In light mode a white swatch on the white list is told apart only by the faint low edge, as the mock draws it; walks cannot switch to light mode, so that case was judged from the colours rather than photographed.
